en.text:
Fusion Grenades have Fastball intrinsically and detonate on impact, stunning <unstoppable/>Unstoppable Champions on hit.

Fusion Grenade Kills refund Grenade Energy based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors: 25%
• Elites: 50% 
• Players, Minibosses, and Bosses: 100%

#ChunkEnergyUnaffected
